body:
Next.js 16 Turbopack builds were failing because `src/proxy.ts` used a reference-style default export (`export default proxy`) which Turbopack's Rust-based AST analysis does not reliably detect as a valid `ExportDefaultDeclaration`. The middleware template validates `mod.proxy || mod.default` must resolve to a function ΓÇö if neither is detected, it throws the "does not export a function" error.

## Changes

- **`src/proxy.ts`**: Replaced the two-step pattern with an inline default declaration:

```ts
// Before
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) { ... }
export default proxy  // reference ΓÇö Turbopack may not detect as ExportDefaultDeclaration

// After
export default async function proxy(request: NextRequest) { ... }
// single ExportDefaultDeclaration + FunctionDeclaration node ΓÇö unambiguous to all AST analyzers
```

The `export const config = { matcher: [...] }` and all business logic (session refresh, security headers) are unchanged.
